description: This file 'CampaignDiagnostic.php' is a PHP script for the SuiteCRM module 'Campaigns'. It handles the display of campaign diagnostics, including UI components, mailbox settings, email server configurations, and scheduler health checks. It also includes logic for rendering status images based on various health indicators.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine used for rendering HTML views within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: define_image
methods.description: Returns HTML image tags with different icons based on the health status indicator.
